content_of_post_to_comment: Is it acceptable madness to buy a physical copy of a book you’ve already read just so it can sit on your shelf? I have this growing list of books I borrowed, returned, and now feel compelled to own purely as ‘trophies’ of the experience. It bothers me like an unscratched itch. Tell me I’m not the only one with this sickness, please? EDIT: Brave New World, The Catcher in the Rye, To Kill a Mockingbird, Normal People, The Argonauts etc.
